**Symbol:** `(*renderer) addArg` — **Path:** `internal/filter/render.go:842` — **Approx fan-in:** ~28 callers

Methodology: I enumerated every function/method declared in non-test `.go` files under `internal/` (272 declarations across ~77 files) and counted call sites for each symbol name repo-wide (word-boundary match, excluding the declaration line itself). Common/generic names (`New`, `Len`, `Next`, `Validate`, `Render`, etc.) were discarded because they collide with many unrelated same-named functions elsewhere in the repo and don't represent a single symbol's real fan-in.

The clear winner among genuinely single, unambiguous symbols is the unexported helper `addArg` on the SQL `renderer` type in the filter/query-rendering engine:

```842:849:internal/filter/render.go
func (r *renderer) addArg(value any) string {
	r.placeholderCounter++
	r.args = append(r.args, value)
	if r.dialect == DialectPostgres {
		return fmt.Sprintf("$%d", r.placeholderOffset+r.placeholderCounter)
	}
	return "?"
}
```

It is called 28 separate times throughout `internal/filter/render.go` — every branch that renders a comparison, `IN`, regex/LIKE, tag/JSON, or list-comprehension condition into SQL calls `r.addArg(...)` to bind a value and get back a placeholder (`?` or `$N`). Representative call sites: `render.go:213, 287, 329, 335, 403, 454-467, 503-509, 530, 536, 567, 570, 583-588, 698, 719, 740-741, 773, 775` (plus one recursive call inside `addBoolArg`, `render.go:863`).

- `Schema.Field` (`internal/filter/schema.go`) — ~19 callers (in `render.go` and `parser.go`)
- `jsonArrayExpr` (`internal/filter/render.go`) — ~16 callers

- `Engine.CompileToStatement` (`internal/filter/engine.go`) — ~8 production callers (its 38 raw hits are dominated by `internal/filter/*_test.go`)

Caveat: this was done via regex/grep-based static counting (no Go toolchain/`go vet`/callgraph tool was available in this environment), so the counts are approximate and could miss/double-count edge cases like reflection-based or interface-dispatched calls.
